notes.title: Patch: Improved Animations, Quest Changes, & more!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Survivors,[/h3]

We’re back with another update, and we’re excited to share some brand-new improvements that’ll enhance your Dead Season experience! 

We’ve added an option to[b] toggle the visibility of the tile grid[/b], giving you more control over your gameplay environment. We’ve also introduced [b]new animations[/b] for throwing items between survivors, adding a touch of flair to your teamwork. You’ll also notice a [b]new particle effect[/b] when dismantling barricades, making those moments feel even more impactful.

We’ve made a [b]major change to the quest item in “The Passage” mission[/b]. You’ll now need to find a [b]Battering Ram to breach the door[/b], which significantly reduces the chance of losing items at the start of the mission. Plus, we’ve improved the lighting on items in the item search dialogue.

On the bug-fixing front, we’ve [b]resolved an issue with the animation of dismantling a barricade[/b] using a chainsaw, ensuring a smoother experience as you clear your path.

You can read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2666550/view/501689139151766380]here[/url]. As always, we’re eager to hear your thoughts on these updates! Your feedback is invaluable. Thank you for being a part of our community, and we hope you enjoy these new features!

The Dead Season Team

notes.title: Patch: Tweaked Difficulty, Controller Support & more!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Survivors,[/h3]

It's been a few weeks since Dead Season released, and - as we’ve stated before - your feedback has not gone unnoticed. Today, we’re rolling out some updates to address some of your points and introduce a feature we’re excited about: controller support! 

We are introducing [b]revised difficulty levels[/b] on Easy and Normal, increased hit chances, reduced jamming chance, and more. This all to keep gameplay dynamic and give you survivors a better and more satisfying chance against the infected!

Additionally, we’ve also made some[b] mission-specific changes to both [i]Daymare [/i]and [i]Helping Hand[/i][/b] regarding the respective alarms at the end of these missions. These will now turn off after a set number of turns!

And finally, we’re bringing some quality-of-life improvements such as the introduction of [b]Controller Support and Cloud Saves. [/b]

If you want to read a full break-down of the changes, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2666550/view/4526773057376747907]you can read the detailed patch notes here.
[/url]
As we continue to improve the game, we hope you enjoy these changes and new features! We’re excited to hear your feedback and see how it changes your Dead Season experience.

The Dead Season Team

If you're still experiencing issues running the game on an AMD card, please let us know[/b] on the Steam Discussions page or Discord so we can look into it! You can read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2666550/view/4526772422646912146]here[/url].

We’re committed to taking in your feedback and trying to make Dead Season as good as possible! As always, we’d appreciate you telling us what you thought of the game (and the changes we’re making) on Steam and on Discord!

notes.title: Pre-Launch FAQ: Your Burning Questions Before the Outbreak!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

Less than a week until Dead Season is finally unleashed on the world, and I figured this might be the perfect time to answer some Frequently Asked Questions! 

[h3]About the game:[/h3]

[u][b]What makes Dead Season, Dead Season?[/b][/u]

The goal in Dead Season is to complete story-driven objectives that push you to escape dangerous situations using whatever weapons you can scavenge. As you progress, you’ll level up, unlock new abilities, and gain the skills needed to survive in increasingly unforgiving environments.

[u][b]How long is the game?[/b][/u]

First and foremost, you’re encouraged to do multiple playthroughs in order to play every level Dead Season has to offer. Additionally, game length will, of course, depend on the speed and difficulty you play at. My estimation would be between 6 and 12 hours of gameplay. If you play as a completionist on hard mode it could take you around 20 hours.

[u][b]Controller & Steam Deck support?[/b][/u]
After tinkering with the controls it works (I suggest using the trackpads!). Aside from that it runs out of the box. Currently there is no controller support, but I plan to do that after release.
			
[u][b]Is there a campaign/story mode?[/b][/u]

Absolutely! Dead Season is a single-player game that’ll have you embark on a journey through 16 missions as you tackle new and unique challenges along the way. Immerse yourself in the narrative through captivating motion comics that propel the story forward.

[u][b]Are there multiple difficulty settings?[/b][/u]

Yes, there are: [b]Easy, Normal, and Hard. [/b]

[b]Easy[/b]: Enemy threat reduced and 5 saves per mission*.
[b]Normal[/b]: Moderate enemy threat and 3 saves per mission.
[b]Hard[/b]: Increased enemy threats and only 1 save per mission.

[i]*'Save per mission' creates a save state from which you can continue if you die. [/i]

[u][b]Are there different characters and classes?[/b][/u]

There are 4 characters: Holly, Matt, Paige and Travis. For each there are a variety of perks to choose from including unique ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958895/1942b45d24ecb709901a4ba5ee5b60662f404874.png[/img]

[u][b]Do permadeath & narrative consequences exist?[/b][/u]

It’s vital to finish each level with the 4 protagonists alive. Though I understand that this may feel unfair at times – especially when you were so close to finishing the level – this is purposely done to fit the narrative and create a unique challenge. This also makes it differ from a lot of other games in the genre where you can rush missions with a single character.

[u][b]Can you recruit and/or upgrade units?[/b][/u]

While you can’t recruit new units, upgrading your characters is a key element of Dead Season. Using the aforementioned talent trees, you can determine the playstyle and purpose of each character. You can respec once per game using the ‘Phoenix’ skill, so if you want this, it will be a tactical decision by you!

[u][b]Multiple endings?[/b][/u]

While there is only one ending, there are multiple crossroads at which you unlock certain levels, encouraging you to replay the game to get the full experience.

[u][b]Is there a randomised element to enemy placement or encounters? [/b][/u]

In Dead Season every run feels different. Each search can lead to a different item, and every encounter is affected by your strategy. Enemy movement is based on what you do. This means no two encounters are the same, enemy location keeps changing, the percentage hit chance and jamming of the gun will force you to adapt, and every play-through feels fresh.

[h3]Release details:[/h3]

[u][b]When will it be released?[/b][/u]

The game is releasing on 8th of October 2024! So: this Tuesday if you’re reading before Tuesday.

[u][b]What is the price?[/b][/u]

The game is retailing at 19.99 USD / 19.75 GBP / 19.50 EUR. With 10-20 hours of gameplay, I hope players will find it offers good value for the experience.

[u][b]What platforms is the game releasing on?[/b][/u]

The game is releasing on Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store!

[h3]Conclusion:[/h3]
Before I wrap up and head towards launch, I want to say: Thank you! All of you. Your incredible support and feedback during everything leading up to the Dead Season launch mean the world to me. Your enthusiasm and input helped shape the game into an even better experience. I’m thrilled to see how you’ll tackle the challenges and I look forward to hearing more about your strategies and survival stories. Keep the feedback coming, and thank you for being a part of the Dead Season community!

notes.title: The Turn-Based RPG Fest is Here, and Dead Season is Shuffling Its Way Into it!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

After months of long and arduous work, [b]Dead Season is finally ready to release next week![/b] As we make our way to launch, I am happy to announce our participation in Steam’s [b]Turn-Based RPG Fest 2024[/b]! 

During the entire festival, you will have the opportunity for some final survival training, because we’re [b]bringing back Dead Season’s Next Fest demo![/b]

So for those who haven't gotten around to it yet, or for the ones that want some more training, this is your final shot before we launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958895/3e018b97b1540f390ffae666c2f4b6079c76364e.png[/img]

[u][b]The End is Here…[/b][/u]

Experience a new world in Dead Season. As the remnants of civilization fight and struggle, [b]band together with other survivors, scavenge and loot as a team making their way through the apocalypse in search for answers and those they left behind.[/b] Learn about their past, the decisions that got them here, and how their past selves can help you now!

[u][b]…And so, It Begins.[/b][/u]

Battle your way through hordes of the undead with strategic moves in order to complete objectives and survive as long as you can! Find items and force your way to freedom through 16 different stages with increasing difficulty and complexity! No stage is like the other, and [b]no decision comes without a price![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958895/2ec0780fd6932b50d484cff4f46c01196de88fb6.png[/img]
Get ready to roll the dice! Will your attacks land? Will your plan work? Or will the odds favor the undead opposition set before you? Shoot, loot, flee, or position — every move counts when the stakes are high, and only the most cunning decisions will tip the scales in your favor.

[h3]Try out Dead Season’s limited-time  Demo starting today, September 30th at 10:00 AM (PDT) to October 7th at 10:00 AM (PDT)![/h3]

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm, 

Pavel

notes.title: Dev Blog 5 - Dead Season is part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I want to thank every single one of you who has already taken the time to play the Dead Season demo and leave valuable feedback. I’m trying to shape this game into its best possible version, and your comments have been incredibly helpful. [b]The Dead Season demo will be available throughout all of Steam’s Next Fest June 2024! It’ll be available from today, 10th June, until 17th June.[/b]

Though some of you will have already seen it, check out the trailer and demo description below for a glimpse of what awaits you in Dead Season:

[previewyoutube=5wjraUkxplo;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo, you'll get a sneak peek into the gripping single-player experience of Dead Season. Start with a tutorial level to get familiar with the game mechanics, then take on two additional levels that introduce you to the gameplay and set the stage for the challenges ahead. 

You’ll face diverse zombie encounters, each demanding strategic thinking. Remember, too much noise attracts more dangerous threats, so you’ll need to plan your moves carefully!

[b]In case you missed it:[/b]
Keep your eyes peeled for our Steam Next Fest stream slots. We’ll be live for an hour on:
[list]
[*] Tuesday, the 11th of June, at 15.00 CEST / 06.00 PT
[*] Thursday, the 13th of June, at 22.00 CEST/ 13.00 PT
[/list]
[b]We hope you’ll find the Next Fest Demo as enjoyable as it was for us to create this experience for all of you![/b]

Please be aware that the Next Fest Demo [b]might include some bugs and unexpected experiences[/b]. If you encounter anything, please share your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666550/discussions/]Steam Discussion Board[/url], I'm eager to hear your thoughts on how you’ve been liking the demo so far! And thank you again for your continued support. 

Stay tuned for more updates!

Best,
Pavel

notes.title: Dead Season - Demo Update - Patch Note 0.5.9.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First and foremost, thank you everyone who has tried out the demo so far, especially those who have shared their feedback and thoughts.

With that said, I’ve now pushed a new update for the demo based on community feedback today:

[b]Key Gameplay Updates:[/b][list]
[*] Weapon accuracy has been moderately increased across all weapons to refine combat, especially in close encounters with zombies.
[*] The sound effect for pressing the "End Turn" button has been changed.
[*] Crawlers and Bloaters now have more HP.
[*] If a survivor dies, you must restart from the last manual save, or restart the mission.
[*] Missions cannot be completed if any survivors are pinned by crawlers.
[/list]
These updates aim to refine combat whilst also emphasizing the urgency of completing objectives quickly and efficiently.

I'm eager to hear your thoughts on these changes! Please share your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666550/discussions/]Steam Discussion Board[/url], and thank you again for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates!

Best,
Pavel
